author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not export test-only utilities (such as a test service layer) from a package's main entrypoint.
fix_shape: move the test layer to a dedicated test subpath/entrypoint instead of the package root export.

author: richburdon
principle: Reuse an existing shared utility instead of writing a new local implementation of the same thing.
fix_shape: import and call the existing helper (e.g. a formatBytes in a common units module) instead of defining a duplicate.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Put a package's public type definitions in its api package rather than in a separate ad hoc types directory.
fix_shape: move the type module's contents into the existing api package and export from there.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Within a package, import its own modules with relative imports, never by importing the package's own published name.
fix_shape: replace the self-referential `@scope/pkg-name` import with a relative import path.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not leave a duplicate copy of a file/module behind when its contents were moved elsewhere; delete the stale one.
fix_shape: remove the now-redundant duplicate file.

author: richburdon
principle: Name a schema/data field for what it represents, not for an unrelated implementation concept such as a UI construct.
fix_shape: rename the field to reflect its actual meaning (e.g. inputSchema instead of formSchema).

author: richburdon
principle: Give a non-trivial exported function a short explanatory comment and name it with a precise action verb rather than a vague one like 'ensure'.
fix_shape: add a one-line doc comment and rename the function to a more specific verb (create/construct/validate/repair).

author: richburdon
principle: Give enum/constant string values that are self-descriptive on their own, not jargon that only makes sense in the circumstance that produced them.
fix_shape: rename the constant/value to something informative independent of context.

author: richburdon
principle: Build a single object up front and pass it through a common, uniform interface shared across similar adapters, rather than passing separate destructured fields per adapter.
fix_shape: construct one object and pass it into the shared container interface instead of individual props.

author: richburdon
principle: Keep an object factory function synchronous; do not make it async merely to perform an internal side effect like schema registration — hoist that out to the caller.
fix_shape: extract the async step (e.g. schema registration) into an explicit input the caller awaits and passes in, keeping make() sync.

author: richburdon
principle: Use a generic, unbranded local variable name (e.g. object) when its specific type is already clear from context, instead of a type-specific name.
fix_shape: rename the variable to the generic term.

author: richburdon
principle: Inline a single-use helper's body at its call site instead of naming an extra intermediate when it does not hurt readability.
fix_shape: inline the helper call directly where it is used.

author: richburdon
principle: Inline a value that is only used once instead of assigning it to an intermediate variable first.
fix_shape: fold the intermediate variable's construction directly into the call that uses it.

author: richburdon
principle: Resolve a user-facing string through translation/i18n at runtime rather than hardcoding a fixed literal that will be displayed to the user.
fix_shape: look up the string via the translation mechanism at render/use time instead of embedding it as a static annotation value.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When defining a Schema for a type identified by a runtime type guard, use Schema.declare with the predicate rather than hand-composing Schema.Any with custom refinement logic.
fix_shape: replace the hand-built Schema.Any.pipe(...) with Schema.declare(isX).

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Do not name a build/bundler entrypoint 'index' when it will be wrapped by additional runtime code around it; name it to reflect that it is not the top-level entry.
fix_shape: pick an entry point name that signals it is wrapped rather than the literal program entry.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Keep two closely coupled types/concepts (a definition and the protocol that wraps it) defined together rather than splitting them across modules in a way that obscures the relationship.
fix_shape: fold the closely related type into the same module/namespace it is wrapped by.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: A function's declared return type must accurately describe what it actually returns, not a related-but-different type.
fix_shape: give the function a return type that reflects the real shape it produces.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Use the project's structured logger, not console.log, and avoid logging on every iteration of a loop or callback where it would spam output.
fix_shape: replace console.log with the log utility and gate/throttle it so it does not fire on every tick.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Log routine, frequent, or internal-detail events at a lower level than info (e.g. debug/verbose), reserving info for meaningful events.
fix_shape: lower the log call's level from info to debug/trace.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a method needs to support a new kind of input, add it as an explicit option and let the implementation decide how to use it, rather than widening the parameter type to a union of unrelated shapes.
fix_shape: add a dedicated option (e.g. a query option) instead of accepting `A | B` as the primary parameter.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Handle HTTP client errors using Effect's native typed-error mechanisms rather than throwing a plain Error from inside an Effect.gen block.
fix_shape: use the platform HTTP client's typed error handling instead of `throw new Error(...)`.

author: richburdon
principle: Before writing new inline logic, check whether an existing helper function already does it and reuse that instead.
fix_shape: call the existing helper instead of re-implementing its logic inline.

author: richburdon
principle: In tests, use the structured logger rather than console.log so output can be filtered or turned off.
fix_shape: replace console.log with the log utility in the test.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Consolidate a legacy or duplicate type alias into the single canonical unified type rather than keeping both around.
fix_shape: remove the legacy alias and use the canonical type (e.g. Obj.Any) in its place.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not keep a method that duplicates a standalone utility function already providing the same capability; use the standalone function.
fix_shape: remove the duplicate method and call the standalone utility instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Migrate call sites onto the single canonical construction API rather than leaving them on a legacy equivalent.
fix_shape: replace the legacy constructor/helper with the canonical one.
